question: What has each of the five actually disclosed about advisor compensation structures?

claims.text: Structure of advisor pay - Edward Jones: The 2025 10-K (published 2026-03-13) states that financial advisors are generally compensated on a commission basis, subject to a minimum guaranteed salary. They may be entitled to additional compensation based on their branch office profitability and the profitability of the Partnership.

Structure of advisor pay - Edward Jones: The firm's 2026 advisory brochure (published 2026-03-27) says its financial advisor compensation creates financial incentives that conflict with the interests of Edward Jones, the advisor and the client. It points to disclosures and to its "Understanding how we are compensated for financial services" document.

Structure of advisor pay - Merrill: Merrill's 2026 advisory brochure (published 2026-10-30) says an advisor earns compensation based on the revenue Merrill earns from the Merrill Lynch Fee paid in the Program. It also lists other revenue from certain, but not all, other fees and costs, revenue from Sales Charges on brokerage transactions, and revenue from referrals to Affiliates. Merrill states that this structure results in conflicts of interest.

Structure of advisor pay - Merrill: The same brochure says Merrill determines the compensation paid to its Advisors on the same basis for all Program assets, without regard to the compensation Merrill or its Affiliates receive. It adds that Advisors receive no additional compensation from Third-Party Firm arrangements. It also says field management compensation is tied to revenues to Merrill and to advisors meeting strategic goals, including growth in assets and liabilities.

Structure of advisor pay - Morgan Stanley: The 2025 10-K (published 2026-02-19) states that the firm sponsors deferred cash-based and stock-based compensation programs that include Wealth Management financial advisors. These generally carry vesting, clawback and cancellation provisions. Deferred compensation for Wealth Management financial advisors is generally 75% cash-based awards and 25% stock-based awards.

Structure of advisor pay - Raymond James: The FY2025 10-K (published 2025-11-25) describes a compensation structure for associates generally, not a separate advisor grid. It cites base salary, incentive bonus and equity compensation, plus retirement and stock plans. It also cites non-qualified deferred compensation plans for associates who meet compensation, production or other criteria.

Structure of advisor pay - Raymond James: The 2026 advisory brochure (published 2026-09-14) says the firm and its financial advisors may receive client referrals from unaffiliated third parties. In some arrangements they share a portion of a flat fee or of the advisory fees with the third party.

adjacent.text: Edward Jones 10-K (published 2026-03-13): the Financial advisor compensation line was $6,969 in 2025, $6,208 in 2024 and $5,218 in 2023, up 12% in '25 vs. '24. Total compensation and benefits was $12,405 in 2025.
